scenario.name: r-cd-model-chained-alt
scenario.description: Depth-1 delegate schedules a depth-2 continue_delegate with explicit alternate model; depth-2 reports observed model/provider.
scenario.notes: Nested model override row; fire sequentially and avoid concurrent continuation rows in the same session.
scenario.registryNotes: Runnable local conversion: parent schedules depth-1 delegate; depth-1 schedules depth-2 delegate with explicit model override and targetSessionKey back to root; root observes depth-2 model return.

invocation.promptTemplate: Proof nonce {{nonce}} depth-1: schedule one depth-2 continue_delegate with model=${OPENCLAW_ALT_MODEL:-}; depth-2 reports current time, observed model/provider, and nonce. Do not mutate files.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the parent request that asks the agent to call continue_delegate for this model row

expectedReceipts.name: child-session-observed
expectedReceipts.description: A nonce-correlated delegate child session/run is observed on the subscribed session stream or session history

expectedReceipts.name: child-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Depth-2 child SERVED provider/model from the row-bound assistant message in the child's own chat.history inside the row run window (after the row anchor, first message carrying the row sentinel; stopReason recorded). sessions.describe model/modelProvider is recorded separately as the persisted SELECTION and alone yields PARTIAL (selection matched; served route unproven). Active fallback or a mixed served window is FAIL (#561/#562 review).

expectedReceipts.name: return-payload
expectedReceipts.description: Delegate return includes the row nonce and observed model/provider summary

expectedReceipts.name: trace-or-session-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: Trace id, span tree, or session-event correlation tying dispatch to child and return

expectedReceipts.name: depth-2-model-byte
expectedReceipts.description: Depth-2 child reports/records the requested alternate provider/model

expectedReceipts.name: depth-1-scheduled-inner
expectedReceipts.description: Depth-1 child emitted sentinel after scheduling the depth-2 delegate with explicit model override

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_delegate tool → continuation.delegate.dispatch → continuation.delegate.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash, length, and delegate mode, holding one continuation.delegate.dispatch span, one continuation.delegate.fire span, and the originating continue_delegate tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: PASS-candidate only when depth-2, not just depth-1, observes the explicit alternate model. If #1103 persists, this row should honestly limit on observed fallback/inheritance.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_delegate tool span to continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire only by shared trace, causal timing, and the reason fingerprint and mode. The collector attributes only the depth-1 dispatch, by the manifest task rendered with the private nonce; the depth-2 dispatch that carries the model override is reviewed by hand. The census established that an accepted entry span cannot be joined to the child run it produced.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_delegate evidence. Joined to the dispatch span only by shared trace and causal timing.

spans.name: openclaw.model.call
spans.notes: Model-call spans exist fleet-wide; they cannot be attributed to a specific continuation entry.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Model and provider identifiers are published literally because they are public product identifiers. Delegate task material is published only as a digest and a length; prompt bodies, raw nonces, raw session keys, and tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: The depth-1 child schedules a depth-2 continue_delegate with the alternate model, and the depth-2 child’s served model in its own transcript equals that model.
controls.negative: A depth-1 child that reports the model is not enough; the depth-2 child must serve it.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: The depth-2 child’s run-window-bound served model equals the requested alternate model. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: Only the persisted selection matched, a depth is not observed, the requested model is unset, or a required receipt is missing. Missing traces keep the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: The depth-2 child serves a different model than requested, including fallback or inheritance.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-model-chained-alt.js fires the depth-1 delegate and reads the depth-2 child transcript.
execution.manual: Manual review locates the depth-2 dispatch in the trace; it cannot supply identity attributes.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Nested delegate/model row. Prefer OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=true. Serialize per session. PASS requires depth-2, not just depth-1, to report the requested model byte.
